about.title: A lifelong connection,
about.body: Strong Quran learning grows through a steady rhythm: clear foundations, focused practice, regular review, and understanding that deepens reflection.

rhythm.title: Sustainable rhythm
rhythm.text: Small, repeatable goals that fit real schedules.

progression.title: Focused progression
progression.text: One rule, passage, or pattern at a time.

reflection.title: Deeper reflection
reflection.text: Vocabulary and meaning connected to recitation.

programs.title: A path shaped around
programs.intro: Build a memorisation rhythm, refine your pronunciation, or understand more of the Arabic you recite.

01.title: Memorise consistently
01.description: Set a realistic daily target, balance new passages with revision, and build a steady routine that protects long-term recall.

02.title: Refine your tajwīd
02.description: Begin with articulation points, practise one rule in short passages, and use regular correction before habits become fixed.

03.title: Understand Quranic Arabic
03.description: Grow recurring Quranic vocabulary, recognise Arabic roots and patterns, and connect language study directly to the verses you recite.

04.title: Pursue Quranic ijāzah
04.description: Follow an advanced pathway in precise recitation, intensive personal review, and study toward a formal chain of transmission.

05.title: Explore Quranic studies
05.description: Study foundations of tafsīr, reasons for revelation, Makki and Madani passages, and an introduction to the Quranic sciences.

approach.imageAlt: A mother and daughter studying Quran together
approach.title: Authentic teaching.
approach.body: Effective study follows a clear sequence: listen carefully, understand the lesson, practise it in short passages, and use correction to refine what you hear and recite.

01.title: Learn with qualified teachers
01.text: Study with experienced teachers shaped by Al-Madinah programmes and Quranic qualifications.

02.title: Choose a fitting format
02.text: Use focused one-to-one teaching or a small-group setting, with morning and evening options.

03.title: Progress with structure
03.text: Follow a programme designed for your level, with practical correction and regular follow-up.

learners.title: A welcoming space for
learners.body: Progress does not require mastering everything at once. Begin with recurring words, familiar passages, or a modest memorisation target, then build steadily from there.
learners.imageAlt: A young learner enjoying an online Quran lesson

memorisation.title: Build a consistent memorisation routine
memorisation.summary: Choose a daily target you can sustain, give revision equal weight, and use a simple weekly review cycle.

tajwid.title: Begin tajwīd in the right sequence
tajwid.summary: Start with where letters are formed, work through one rule at a time, and seek regular feedback on short passages.

arabic.title: Understand more of what you recite
arabic.summary: Learn recurring vocabulary in context, notice root patterns, and let reading, listening, and meaning reinforce one another.

cta.title: Begin gently.
cta.body: Share your level and goals to find a suitable pathway in memorisation, tajwīd, Arabic, ijāzah, or Quranic studies.

footer.tagline: Personal Quran teaching, rooted in care, clarity, and a sincere love of learning.
footer.intention: Learning with intention, wherever you are.
